name: shallow_ford
notes: Shallow ford (~0.2-0.4 m): clear water over a gravel and cobble bed, visible stones tinted green-brown by depth, a few stepping stones breaking the surface with wet dark rims. Height = WATER SURFACE (ripples) except the emergent stones.
